📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

The future of Virgil van Dijk continues to be a much-discussed talking point going into the winter months.

The legendary Liverpool captain will see his current contract expire next June as things stand, with the Dutchman on track to become a free agent just before his 36th birthday.

Transfer insider Graeme Bailey recently claimed that there’s a strong chance of the veteran defender being offered at least a 12-month extension at Anfield, with Andoni Iraola unsurprisingly keen to keep hold of his skipper.

In his latest Liverpool Confidential feature for the Daily Mail, Lewis Steele reported of fervent interest from Serie A in Van Dijk amid ongoing speculation over the centre-back’s future.

The journalist wrote: ‘One source told me this week that AC Milan and other Italian clubs have been sniffing around Van Dijk for some time, with talks ongoing internally at those sides.

‘Milan owner Gerry Cardinale and influential adviser Zlatan Ibrahimovic are stated to be huge admirers of Van Dijk, who turns 36 next summer.’.

While the Rossoneri appear determined to pounce on any uncertainty over Van Dijk’s future, Steele added that the 35-year-old is ‘keen’ to extend his contract at Liverpool.

(Photo by Carl Recine/Getty Images).

Industry observers note that want more Empire of the Kop coverage? Add us as a preferred source on Google to your favourites list for news you can trust.

Any reports of interest in the Dutchman from other clubs will naturally trigger a level of concern among Reds supporters, but it’s natural that there’d be a queue of suitors for one of the best defenders of his (perhaps any) generation when he’s seven months away from becoming a free agent.

Until such time that a final decision is communicated by LFC, fans’ nerves will be frayed as to Van Dijk’s future. When we’ve already seen Mo Salah and Andy Robertson depart this year, the loss of another modern-day great in 2027 would represent a further gut punch for Kopites.

However, it’s worth remembering that when the Liverpool captain last penned a new contract in April 2025, he was just over two months away from leaving on a free, so he won’t panic even if there might be considerable gnashing of teeth outside of those involved in negotiations over his future.

James Pearce recently advised Reds supporters not to expect a ‘quick resolution’ over the defender’s situation, so for now, it seems that the best way for Van Dijk to secure a new deal at Anfield is to maintain the strong performance levels he’s shown so far this season.

The noise over his future is sure to continue for the time being, but we remain confident that everything will come together in due course and that our iconic number 4 will continue to grace the famous red shirt in the 2027/28 campaign.

💡 Key Takeaways

  • Bayern Munich's chief executive has confirmed Vincent Kompany is expected to return to the dugout on Friday, less than a month after collapsing at the club's training ground.
  • Kompany collapsed on October 23 while watching Bayern's Under-23 side and reportedly suffered from seizures.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

By MICHAEL PAVITT, SPORTS REPORTER.

Published: 14:59 EST, 18 November 2026 | Updated: 15:01 EST, 18 November 2026.

Bayern Munich's chief executive has confirmed Vincent Kompany is expected to return to the dugout on Friday, less than a month after collapsing at the club's training ground.

Kompany collapsed on October 23 while watching Bayern's Under-23 side and reportedly suffered from seizures.

The 40-year-old, who suffered a dislocated shoulder in the fall, underwent tests in hospital which determined that a 'meningeal irritation' had been the cause of his collapse.

Sources indicate that if left untreated meningeal irritation can become meningitis. The meninges are the membranes around the brain and spinal cord.

Kompany was discharged from hospital the following week to continue his recovery at home.

The Belgian coach is now set to return to the dugout when Bayern face Cologne on Friday, with Kompany due to also address the media tomorrow morning.

Vincent Kompany is set to return to the Bayern Munich dugout for their Bundesliga match on Friday.

Kompany's return was officially confirmed by Bayern chief executive Jan-Christian Dreesen.

According to recent reports, 'Yes, Vincent is in pretty good spirits. I ran into him today,' Dreesen told German outlet Abendzeitung.

'The meningeal irritation has healed. He has already undergone shoulder surgery.'.

Kompany had led training for the first time since his collapse earlier this week, with his arm reportedly in a sling following his shoulder injury.

He had missed five matches during his recovery with Bayern winning two and drawing against Borussia Dortmund in the Bundesliga.

The German champions also beat Atletico Madrid in the Champions League in his absence, as well as progressing in the DFB Cup.

Kompany's assistant Aaron Danks had overseen the first team during his recovery.

Danks previously worked as Kompany's assistant at Anderlecht before deputising for Dean Smith and Steven Gerrard at Aston Villa and Michael Carrick at Middlesbrough.

Kompany has missed five matches following his collapse at Bayern's training ground on October 23.

Bayern had stressed they wanted to give Kompany as much time as required to recover before returning to work.

The German giants play eight matches in the next month, including two matches in the Champions League, before the Bundesliga takes its winter break.

Reports had emerged after Kompany's collapse that club officials had been concerned by his irregular eating habits, as well as barely exercising, drinking excessive amounts of coffee, and taking on too much work.

Bayern sporting director Max Eberl dismissed the claims last month, reiterating that Kompany's illness had been the cause of his collapse rather than his workload.

Il mister Gennaro Gattuso ha rilasciato delle dichiarazioni ai microfoni di Dazn e LSC poco dopo il fischio finale di Lazio-Lecce.

Il mister Gennaro Gattuso ha rilasciato delle dichiarazioni ai microfoni di Dazn e LSC poco dopo il fischio finale di Lazio-Lecce, terminato 3-0 grazie alla doppietta di Noslin e alla rete di Frattesi.

CLICCA QUI E SEGUI LAZIOPRESS.IT ANCHE SU INSTAGRAM.

According to recent reports, non siamo partiti benissimo, eravamo appannati, poi la squadra ha fatto bene. Lecce scomodo, ti giocano addosso, non è stato semplice ma sono orgoglioso per mentalità e voglia. Ieri avevo detto di non essere preoccupato, li vedo in settimana, oggi hanno giocato Leite, Doekhi e Pedraza che non avevano mai giocato insieme ma ero tranquillo perché li vedo quando arrivano in campo, c'è grande spirito e dobbiamo continuare così. A destra giochiamo in un modo e a sinistra in un altro, Taylor ci dà qualità, è merito dei ragazzi che ci stanno mettendo tantissima mentalità e senso di appartenenza. Diamo merito a questi ragazzi, stanno facendo qualcosa di incredibile.

According to recent reports, rovella? Può dare più verticalizzazione, ci darà una mano. Ora possiamo anche fare 4-2-3-1, poi vedremo. Dele-Bashiru meriterebbe di più, abbiamo diversi giocatori. Ora servono minuti nelle gambe a Rovella che è mancato per tantissimo tempo, è un giocatore importante. Cosa manca? Sbagliare ci sta, giochiamo a velocità alte, mi interessa la mentalità ed è una sorpresa come stiamo tenendo botta. Sono soddisfatto, si vuole sempre qualcosa in più ma con questi ritmi gli errori tecnici ci possono stare. Non siamo stati sempre precisi, possiamo migliorare nella lettura delle partite.

Dimmi quando è una partita facile? Non esistono. Ci hanno messo in difficoltà i primi 10/15 minuti, quando si abbassava Reda e i due braccetti. Ci chiudevano le giocate, dopo sulle seconde palle squadra troppo verticale. Il primo tempo abbiamo avuto sei o sette calci d’angolo. Il secondo tempo siamo entrati con un piglio diverso, mi ha sorpreso la mentalità ancora una volta. Abbiamo trovato spazio dentro nel secondo tempo, dovevamo andare più verticali anche noi. Anche Noslin, al di là dei gol, ha sbagliato tanto oggi.

Industry observers note that C’era Pedraza al 70° che non ne poteva più. Non ero preoccupato, oggi abbiamo cambiato tre giocatori che non hanno mai giocato insieme, ma quando vedi come si allenano in settimana ci sta che uno può giocare meno bene ma questa squadra c’ha gamba e lo hanno dimostrato.

La soddisfazione più grande, merito loro. Il fatto di farsi trovare pronti e giocare partite in questo modo è una grande soddisfazione. Alla fine quando le cose vanno bene, perché nel secondo tempo abbiamo rischiato poco e li abbiamo tenuti là, fai fatica a cambiare quando è così. Ti viene il braccino. La motivazione è questa. In quel momento non sapevo chi togliere perché vedevo una squadra ben messa in campo.

Le ultime dai campi e le probabili formazioni di Juventus-Venezia:.

La Juventus, dopo la sosta per le nazionali, è pronta a tornare in campo in campionato per sfidare il Venezia domenica alle 12:30. Contro i lagunari Spalletti si affiderà al 3-4-2-1: in porta ci sarà Vicario. In difesa spazio a Gatti, Bremer e Lucumì. A centrocampo sulla destra giocherà McKennie, in mezzo spazio a Douglas Luiz e Koopmeiners, mentre a sinistra è toccherà a Cabal. Sulla trequarti sarà confermato Alajbegovic che avrà al suo fianco Kolo Muani. Entrambi giocheranno alle spalle di Woltemade. Nelle ore che precederanno la partita Luciano Spalletti proverà a recuperare tre giocatori, almeno per la panchina: i nomi sono quelli di Nico Gonzalez, Zeki Celic e Andrea Cambiaso. (da Torino, Camillo Demichelis).

Yeboah è l’ultimo a rientrare dei nazionali e Nicola studia l’ipotesi di riproporre la doppia punta a Torino, con Lauberbach al fianco di Adams. In mezzo out Basic per affaticamento, c'è Busio per affiancare Kike Perez e Sohm, con Hainaut e Haps (fermi anche Mazzocchi e Correia per risentimento al flessore) esterni del 3-5-2. Davanti a Stankovic scalpita Bella-Kotchap, ma dovrebbero essere confermati Halhal, Moreno e Juan Jesus in difesa. (da Venezia, Daniele Najjar).

L’allenatore del Napoli Massimiliano Allegri ha parlato in conferenza stampa nel post-partita di Napoli-Torino. Ecco quanto sottolineato da IamNaples.it.

“Vergara si è fatto male, non so per quanto tempo, l’anno scorso era una novità, ha un dispendio di energie mentali diverso, questi infortuni arrivano anche per questo motivo. I ragazzi sono stati bravi soprattutto a mettersi al pari del Torino per intensità, mi è piaciuta anche l’attenzione sui calci piazzati e in certi momenti della partita, prendevamo gol da otto partite, è stato importante non prenderlo. De Bruyne? Bisogna essere realisti, martedì abbiamo una partita bella da giocare ma, guardando il calendario, abbiamo sempre pensato che ci giocassimo il passaggio del turno nelle ultime tre partite. Noa Lang è stato bravo, non solo ha fatto l’assist ma ha anche recuperato il pallone da cui nasce il gol. Il calcio di Allegri non esiste, esiste il calcio proposto dal Napoli che deve recuperare qualche giocatore in più. In queste sedici partite, tranne che a Genova dove abbiamo fatto un primo tempo brutto ma nel secondo abbiamo fatto bene, abbiamo concesso dei gol agli avversari in maniera troppo facile”.

Dal nostro inviato al Maradona Ciro Troise.

Le ultime dai campi e le probabili formazioni di Sassuolo-Genoa:.

According to recent reports, D'Aversa sembra orientato a ripartire dal 4-3-3, ma resta aperto il dubbio legato a un possibile passaggio alla difesa a tre, soluzione provata da Aquilani a Roma prima dell'esonero. Contro il Genoa, Muric potrebbe tornare titolare nel ballottaggio tra i pali, con Walukiewicz, Idzes, Caleta-Car e Doig in difesa; a centrocampo Sulemana (o Bakola) e Thorstvedt ai lati di Matic. La novità più importante riguarda però il reparto offensivo: Berardi è pronto a tornare titolare, Esposito è in vantaggio su Bowie per il ruolo di centravanti, con Laurienté a completare il tridente. Non ci sarà invece Vasilije Adzic, fermato dal problema al ginocchio accusato con il Montenegro, resta ancora fuori anche Volpato. (da Reggio Emilia, Antonio Parrotto).

Industry observers note that L'infermeria si è svuotata, Daniele De Rossi adesso ha "problemi" di abbondanza specialmente sulla trequarti. Il tecnico rossoblù per la sfida di Reggio Emilia contro il Sassuolo può ruotare diversi elementi alle spalle della prima punta che sarà Osmajic. Con ogni probabilità a partire dal primo minuto dovrebbero essere Baldanzi ed El Shaarawy con Ehizibue ed Ellertsson sulle corsie. A centrocampo ancora in dubbio Frendrup per via di un problema alla caviglia e quindi partiranno titolari Wiafe e Traoré. In difesa a protezione della porta di Bijlow spazio a Marcandalli, Ostigard e Vasquez. (da Genova, Andrea Piras).

It has been revealed that “Una partita molto importante, si sapeva. In campionato dobbiamo risalire. Nel primo tempo potevamo fare più di qualche gol, per poi fare un altro tipo di partita. Ma anche nella ripresa siamo stati bravi a difendere compatti e ad essere pazienti nel cercare il gol. Le mie condizioni? Mi sono sentito abbastanza a mio agio, mi sono allenato molto bene in queste quattro settimane. Nello spogliatoio quando si vince è sempre, ovviamente. A Manchester ci aspetta una gara bellissima contro una squadra fortissima e in uno stadio difficilissimo. Andiamo lì per fare una bella partita. Cacciamani dal vivo mi è piaciuto tanto, avevo dalla mia parte due esterni di gamba. E’ stata una buona gara, mi sentivo bene: sono felice. Vergara e Lang? Speriamo Antonio sia meno grave possibile, l’ho rincuorato: sto quando ci sta male. Anche perché ne ho provate tante. Lang ci ha dato sempre una grande mano, non si è mai tirato indietro. Ora fa uno sforzo che in passato non ha mai fatto, dobbiamo riconoscere anche questo. È anche difficile sentire dei fischi, non siamo tutti uguali. Dobbiamo riconoscere quello che sta facendo Noa, che si sta sacrificando e noi lo stiamo facendo”.

Si va verso il 3-4-2-1 con Okoye in porta, Abankwah, Palma e Solet a comporre la linea difensiva. Sulle fasce Vojvoda e Kamara, con al centro Piotrowski e Karlstrom. 📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

At the final whistle, the first song the stadium DJ played was Spirit of the Blues and how those relieved Evertonians lapped it up after a week of angst.

It has been revealed that their team had been on the precipice of a defeat that would have exacerbated all the frustrations that bubbled away following the chaotic conclusion to the transfer window. Indeed, it was 10 seconds over the allotted five minutes of added time when the ball fell to Ainsley Maitland-Niles.

It had been three years since the former Arsenal full-back had played in the Premier League – his last goal in England was on October 30, 2019, in an EFL Cup tie with Liverpool at Anfield that ended 5-5 – and he would not have joined Everton if their attempt to sign Kenny Tete from Fulham had not failed.

But here he was 30 yards from goal, with no need to break his stride as Manchester United’s backtracking defenders presented him with an invitation to shoot. So that’s what he did. With one perfectly timed swish of his right foot, an unlikely hero transformed the mood of a club.

Industry observers note that "That is something SPECIAL!"Ainsley Maitland-Niles earns a draw for Everton on his debut with an unbelievable 96th minute strike! 🤯 pic.twitter.com/HNdx9PxrUP.

“Brilliant technique,” said David Moyes, Everton’s manager, who had only introduced Maitland-Niles in the 77th minute after James Garner had succumbed to cramp and could run no more. “We are still getting to know Ainsley but that was a brilliant goal.”.

Only those with the coldest hearts would begrudge Everton this point, which was especially hard-earned given they had conceded an 88th-minute header to Benjamin Sesko. But there is no chance a disbelieving Michael Carrick will feel that way.

It has been revealed that benajmin Sesko puts Manchester United back in front! 👊 pic.twitter.com/MF3A9LyaY8.

According to recent reports, united should, really, have won this game comfortably. Everton were there to be exploited and when Bryan Mbuemo put them ahead early in the second half, they should have powered away into the distance. Everton’s effort was good but they were in danger of losing hope.

In a recent development, yet, incredibly, United gave Everton two helping hands. They had not been in a position to assist last Tuesday evening, when phone calls from Merseyside to Old Trafford to take Joshua Zirkzee on loan were met with rejection. But the second half display more than made up for that.

“We’re bitterly disappointed,” said Carrick, who was one step removed from having steam puffing from his ears. “All the work that went into putting us in that position at different stages to then come away like that… it’s not a great feeling. It feels like a defeat. It’s a bit of a cliché to say.”.

According to recent reports, but clichés are true. First United were passive when Tyrique George crashed in a brilliant right-footed drive in the 83rd minute and then, after Sesko profited from Jordan Pickford’s weak hands, they were passive again in allowing Everton to build the move that ended up with Maitland-Niles’ howitzer.

In a recent development, how had it come to this? It was beautiful bedlam, the kind of joy that only football delivers, but for long periods it felt like it was an opportunity for United. There was anticipation that Everton’s fans would create a furnace but there was also the fear it would be dispiritingly quiet.

Had this fixture been at Goodison Park, with its steep stands, tight confines and acoustics that split your ears, United would have been aware of the siege mentality as soon as their bus rolled up outside the stadium but their latest sparkling home is rather more hospitable.

This is no criticism of the home crowd – it is anything but. Why should it always fall to them to bail out the failings of those in charge when those in charge, specifically the executives and recruitment department, have given them scant reason to have hope?

The route to victory for United, then, was relatively straightforward: for all Everton’s initial huff and puff, it always appeared that it would be a case of the away team repeating the simple things, retaining their concentration and waiting for a breakthrough.

It has been revealed that it could have come as early as the eighth minute. Luke Shaw’s deep cross to the back post picked out Mbuemo, whose cushioned header invited Bruno Fernandes to take aim but the Portuguese’s volley clipped the crossbar with Pickford stranded.

Recent findings suggest that united dominated and Marcus Rashford was central to it all, a scampering presence down the left who gave Merlin Röhl, playing as an auxiliary right-back, all kinds of problems. The only thing missing from his opening 45 minutes was a goal.

Recent findings suggest that when Mbuemo scored so early after the break, it felt as if this was going to be one puncture too many for Everton to withstand and the anticipation was United would get the job done. In all fairness to Moyes, however, he was not in the mood to accept excuses.

His substitutions were all positive, with Jack Grealish changing the mood and Hayden Hackney providing dynamism. But it was the former Middlesbrough man who drove forward to give George, whose loan move from Chelsea was made permanent in June, the opportunity to smash an 83rd-minute bullet past Senne Lammens.

"That was unanswerable!"What a way for Tyrique George to open his account for Everton! 🔵 pic.twitter.com/c0HPRjWUia.

Recent findings suggest that “I told the players there would be no excuses and the players all agreed,” Moyes said. “They have hugely bought into it. And, you know, sometimes when you have [fewer] players it means everybody has to be ready. Sometimes when you have a small squad you have to find a way of making it work.”.

They did just that. Pickford should have saved the header from Sesko that looked as though it had given United the lift, but Everton, with their manager belligerent and their fans sensing all was not lost, had other ideas. The noise they generated as Maitland-Niles’s goal went in was unique to this stadium.

It has been revealed that as Moyes celebrated, shaking his fists and revelling in the positive turn of events, Carrick put his hand across his face and shook his head repeatedly. All the while, Everton’s fans sang I guess that’s why they call it the Blues. United’s head coach certainly had them. Everton, simply, had relief.

It’s amazing. Everyone wants to start like that and fortunately I did. I put my foot through it and it ended up in the top corner which I’m happy about.

Industry observers note that I came here to work hard. It’s a team full of hard workers and I fit right in. I’m going to show I can pull my weight and give as much as everyone else, if not a little bit more.

Industry observers note that good afternoon and welcome to live coverage of Everton vs Manchester United from Hill Dickinson Stadium. The hosts have made a creditable start on the field but four points from their opening two games cannot gloss over the discontent fostered by the owners and executives because of the credibility gap between their talk about recruitment and their paltry achievements.

The fact that their comeback against Bournemouth to earn a draw last week was achieved with Beto, Tim Iroegbunum and Iliman Ndiaye on the field and all three have now been sold with only Jack Grealish returning on loan to compensate tells its own story.

According to recent reports, speak to supporters and it is emblematic of ownership, they fear, who are prioritising Roma and view the Hill Dickinson as a terrific multisport and concert venue with a heritage football club attached. The bullishness of Angus Kinnear, the chief executive, rings hollower with each pronouncement and it is little wonder that the fans are so disenchanted.

Industry observers note that david Moyes will not walk away but once again he has been sent into the fray against teams with £250m midfields armed with a spud gun. Having said that, we should not underestimate his capacity to rally the old “dogs of war” spirit even if the crowd is still yearning more for a “school of science” revival.

According to recent reports, manchester United won on their first visit to the Hill Dickinson last season when Benjamin Sesko came off the bench to score the only goal of the game and give Michael Carrick a fifth win in six league games as caretaker manager. They were far more fluid in their forward play during the victory over Ipswich last week but it was against an error-stricken defence and they continued to be as worryingly open at the back as they had been against Hull City in the opening round of fixtures with Luke Shaw and Lisandro Martínez having brain fades.

In a recent development, shaw is a doubt today, along with Mason Mount, while Amad Diallo, Matthijs de Ligt, Carlos Baleba and Manuel Ugarte have all been ruled out. Only Christian Norgaard is absent for Everton but so thin is their squad, they will cast covetous glances at Man Utd’s bench, not least at Joshua Zirkzee who was the subject of a very late rejected bid on deadline day.

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

By MATT BARLOW, FOOTBALL WRITER.

Published: 13:55 EST, 18 November 2026 | Updated: 15:04 EST, 18 November 2026.

Two football images adorn the walls of Martin Tyler’s upcoming home or at least they will when everything is in order.

Tyler has recently moved house and the large, framed photograph of Teddy Sheringham scoring for Nottingham Forest against Liverpool, the only goal of the first Premier League game broadcast live by Sky is still on the floor by the front door.

From wherever it ends up, it will project a moment in time when everything changed for Tyler, having walked away from a steady job at ITV and taken a leap of faith as lead commentator for the upcoming satellite channel.

'A new frontier,' admits Tyler, the undisputed ‘Voice of the Premier League’ by the time he left the role at Sky, more than 30 years later.

It has been revealed that 'We didn’t know where it would take us, so that was a special day. Feeling a bit like a pioneer. Wondering whether we were all on a fool’s errand. Some people turned down the job I accepted because of the risk. My kids were four and two at the time.

Sources indicate that 'We used to travel to the games by train in those days, and we would look out of the window and count the satellite dishes as we passed through a major town. We didn’t know whether it was going to work. I wasn’t sure anybody would be watching.

Legendary football commentator Martin Tyler has released a book: TALES FROM THE GANTRY.

Tyler was the undoubted 'Voice of the Premier League' by the time he left Sky Sports in 2023.

'It was slow off the ground and there was a feeling within the game against live football, that people wouldn’t go to the games if they were televised live, and it ended up the opposite. Attendances have gone up, an amazing paradox. Now you can’t get a ticket.'.

Televised football has come a long way since Tyler’s first commentary game, Southampton v Sheffield Wednesday in the old Division Two in 1974, shot with just four cameras for Southern Television.

Sources indicate that 'Now if you don’t have 24 cameras you can feel a bit short-changed,' he laughs. 'I worked at ITV for about 17 years, most of it commentating and you would get a crew on match day who had been doing Coronation Street or Emmerdale Farm in the week and a match director from light entertainment.'.

According to recent reports, the Premier League has come a long way, too. Some might argue too far. It has led football from its roots as the working man’s game to a place where clubs are owned by nations states and mired in the legal complications of the Manchester City case.

Tyler wants to reserve comment on City’s financial offences until sentencing is passed, aware he is inextricably bound to their success because of his iconic commentary for Sergio Aguero’s winner in the 93rd minute against Queen’s Park Rangers to snatch the Premier League title from Manchester United in 2012.

'I’ve always said you won’t see anything like it again, and I stick to that,' he claims, although he the 'Aguero moment’ as it has become commonly known probably means less to him than it does to others.

He is proud to deliver the words but insists those moments belong to the players, the clubs and the fans, not to him.

Ask about his favourite game from three decades in the Premier League and Tyler instinctively pulls Liverpool’s 4-3 comeback win against Newcastle in 1996 from the thrillers he has called.

His own footballing background, meanwhile, could hardly be any further from the Premier League’s glitzy, moneyed elite.

According to recent reports, tyler has always supported Woking and played as an amateur for Corinthian-Casuals. 'The law was you couldn’t get paid,' he says. 'We were on expenses only and they weren’t dodgy expenses. If I went on the tube to Leytonstone, I got the tube fare repaid and no more.

'I played for five years at that level and never got a penny because that was the rule. I played my last game in 1973 and within two years’ they got rid of it because so many people were bending the rules. An opposition player told me their team were on £75 a game.'.

Tyler reflected on his time in the game as a player, coach and commentator with Daily Mail Sport's Matt Barlow.

He was famously on commentary for Sergio Aguero's title-winning moment in 2012.

From a cricketing family, Tyler was on the books at Surrey where he twice served as 12th man and lived for a time with Bob Willis, who became one of England’s greatest fast bowlers after moving on to Warwickshire.

Recent findings suggest that his manager for a time at Casuals was Surrey legend Micky Stewart, who had also played for the famous amateur football club before turning professional at Charlton. In those days it was possible for the multi-talented to hold down a decent career in two sports.

An afternoon in Tyler’s company is just as likely to involve digressions into non-league football, where he worked as an assistant to Alan Dowson at clubs including Woking and Hampton & Richmond, as it is into the Premier League.

He might regale you with a story about Arsene Wenger and the time, on the way to the gantry at Wigan Athletic, he slipped deeper than he realised into long conversation with the then Arsenal boss about rioting in Paris and almost missed his pre-match slot.

According to recent reports, and he might pivot from there into Wenger’s fierce rivalry with Sir Alex Ferguson. 'I have seen Arsene very, very grumpy,' says Tyler. 'When he lost the FA Cup semi-final when Dennis Bergkamp missed the penalty and Ryan Giggs scored.

'I have never seen a manager so angry because he knew he had handed over not only an FA Cup final place but also the domination they enjoyed at that time. They had done the Double in 98 and he felt that was not only about losing a match but losing their psychological edge over their greatest rivals. He was livid. Talk about winning and losing with dignity.'.

But there’s every chance he will reminisce about the time when, as a schoolboy Woking supporter in the terrible winter of 1962-63 he was rewarded for volunteering to paint the stands with an invitation to travel on the team bus to an Amateur Cup tie at Lydbrook Athletic.

'We left Woking at seven on the morning of the match for a two o’clock kick-off in Gloucestershire and by nine we were digging the bus out of a snowdrift on the A4,' notes Tyler. 'We got there at four, no floodlights, and they had marked the lines on the snow with blue soap powder but there was no way we could play. We turned around to go back, got stuck in Cheltenham and had to stay for the night.'.

The only other footballing image on display in Tyler’s home is a photograph of him and Dowson celebrating as the final whistle confirmed their Hampton & Richmond side as Isthmian League champions in 2016.

Tyler has had a hugely varied career, all the way from grassroots level right to the top.

Tyler even worked as an assistant coach to Alan Dowson at several Non-League clubs.

TALES FROM THE GANTRY: Letters from a Lifetime in Football by Martin Tyler is published by Pitch and out now HERE.

After collecting the trophy, Tyler jumped into his car, drove north and less than 24 hours later was at the King Power Stadium to see Leicester crowned champions of England.

In a recent development, 'The greatest fairytale story in the Premier League,' as he claims. 'I had sampled that in a tiny non-league way, then taken those feelings with me to Leicester where it was multiplied a million times, but I could tell the world a tiny bit about how wonderful they must be feeling.'.

It has been revealed that the range of his experience is vast. From amateur football in the 60s, through regional television and ITV to Sky’s Premier League revolution. He commentates regularly and coaches at Woking’s academy and has written a book.

It is a wonderful compilation of 110 essays, the reflections on his lifetime in football. 'The random thoughts of a football obsessive,' as he likes to call it.

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Gigi Orlandini, doppio ex di Atalanta-Inter in programma domani, ha parlato delle due formazioni nerazzurre ai microfoni di derbyderbyderby. Queste alcune delle sue considerazioni:.

“È difficile dire da cosa dipendano le difficoltà di approccio mostrate dall'Inter. Guardando alla rosa che ha a disposizione, ritengo che l'Inter sia ancora la squadra più forte del campionato. Non bisogna considerare soltanto gli undici titolari, ma anche i giocatori che ha a disposizione in panchina: sono calciatori che probabilmente giocherebbero con continuità anche in altre squadre. È una rosa completa e credo che, alla lunga, in Italia sia ancora la squadra da battere. In Europa, invece, sta incontrando qualche difficoltà in più, ma questo è un problema che riguarda un po' il calcio italiano in generale. Sono tanti anni che se ne parla, ma non si riesce a trovare una soluzione”.

Arriviamo quindi alla partita di Bergamo: quali potrebbero essere, secondo lei, le principali chiavi tattiche dell'incontro? Qual è il suo pronostico?

In a recent development, “Non lo so. Se avessi fatto un'intervista qualche anno fa, avrei pronosticato un risultato diverso. Anche se negli ultimi anni l'Atalanta ha sempre sofferto un po' l'Inter. Anche quando c'era Gasperini e la squadra giocava bene, contro i nerazzurri faceva davvero fatica: si parla di sette o otto sconfitte, spesso anche pesanti. L'Inter è una squadra forte e, quando è in giornata e sta bene fisicamente, è difficile da contrastare. Devi sperare che i suoi giocatori non siano al massimo della condizione e che, al contrario, la tua squadra sia al 100%. L'Atalanta giocherà davanti al proprio pubblico e arriva dopo la sosta per le nazionali, con la voglia di tornare in campo.

Sources indicate that spero che i giocatori rientrati dalle rispettive nazionali, parlo soprattutto di quelli dell'Atalanta, non abbiano avuto problemi fisici. Ripeto, secondo me la partita dipenderà molto dalle condizioni dell'Inter. Se i nerazzurri saranno al massimo e giocheranno al meglio delle loro possibilità, sarà difficile contrastarli, perché hanno a disposizione giocatori davvero importanti per il nostro campionato”.

C'è un giocatore dell'Atalanta e uno dell'Inter che, secondo lei, potrebbero risultare particolarmente determinanti per l'andamento della partita?

“In questo momento, per l'Atalanta può essere il collettivo l'elemento in grado di mettere in difficoltà l'Inter. Non vedo un singolo giocatore che possa fare la differenza contro i nerazzurri, ma credo che l'Atalanta debba puntare sul gioco di squadra e sulla compattezza del gruppo. Anche perché i valori tecnici dei giocatori a disposizione sono comunque importanti. Dall'altra parte, l'Inter ha diversi giocatori pericolosi: ci sono Thuram, Çalhanoğlu e tanti altri calciatori che, in qualsiasi momento della partita, possono trovare la giocata decisiva e farti vincere la gara”.

L’allenatore del Torino Ignazio Abate ha parlato in conferenza stampa nel post-partita di Napoli-Torino. Ecco quanto sottolineato da IamNaples.it:.

It has been revealed that “Belghali si porta dietro un problema al ginocchio da varie settimane, nel secondo tempo stava cambiando l’inerzia della gara nei primi venticinque minuti, dobbiamo migliorare col lavoro quotidiano la qualità nelle scelte e la cattiveria. Cacciamani? Dipende da lui sui margini di crescita, sta migliorando tanto nelle due fasi, deve crescere nell’ultimo terzo di campo. Ci portiamo dietro la personalità e il coraggio di giocare in un grande stadio contro una grande squadra che ha meno punti di quelli che merita, ci manca qualcosa negli ultimi venticinque metri. La squadra ha avuto una buonissima gestione della palla, succede troppo poco rispetto a quello che proponiamo. Ho provato un’emozione forte, ho incontrato il mister a cui sono molto legato. Qui è iniziata la mia carriera da calciatore del Napoli, avevo un nonno con 24 abbonamenti del Napoli. È uno stadio che ti regala emozioni forti, è un popolo passionale. Biraghi ha avuto un affaticamento al flessore l’altro ieri, su Rodriguez è una questione su cui non ho potere decisionale. Ho invertito le mezzale ad inizio ripresa perchè è cambiata la pressione del Napoli, è stata un po’ una gara a scacchi. La situazione del gol nasce da un calcio d’angolo del Napoli, siamo ripartiti, abbiamo perso palla troppo facilmente e poi è stato facile per McTominay. Se gli concedi stop e tiro, conosciamo le sue qualità”.

Dal nostro inviato al Maradona Ciro Troise.

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Il mister Gennaro Gattuso ha rilasciato delle dichiarazioni in conferenza stampa poco dopo il fischio finale di Lazio-Lecce.

Il mister Gennaro Gattuso ha rilasciato delle dichiarazioni in conferenza stampa poco dopo il fischio finale di Lazio-Lecce.

CLICCA QUI E SEGUI LAZIOPRESS.IT ANCHE SU INSTAGRAM.

Mancano otto punti per fare la prima festa. Per il resto ne parleremo quando amncano 8-9 partite. Stupito sì, ma per la mentalità. I primi 15 minuti di oggi non sono andati benissimo, dopo molto meglio, abbiamo sofferto un po' sui nostri calci piazzati a favore. Eravamo un po' piantati sulle seconde palle. Secondo tempo molto orgogliosi della mentalità, della prestazione, non li abbiamo fatti respirare. Era da un po' di tempo che sbagliavamo sempre i secondi tempi, a questo giro siamo stati sul pezzo e li abbiamo messi in grandissima difficoltà.

Gattuso avrà un merito su quel che sta facendo la Lazio? Per come lavorano in allenamento. Ieri ero tranquillo, oggi abbiamo messo in campo Diogo, Pedraza,. La tranquillità me la danno i dati, il senso di appartenenza. Mi prendo questo merito: aver fatto diventare in pochissimo tempo questa squadra una famiglia.

Industry observers note that io ho giocato con otto palloni d'oro nella mia carriera. Taylor vede cose che gli altri non vedono. Gli altri avrebbero tirato di piattone, io sinceramente già lo stavo mandando a quel paese. Nel mio modo di pensare il calcio, quella giocata non m'è passata neanche per l'anticamera del cervello. Dico Rui Costa, dai.

Frattesi? Io non ho salvato la vita a nessuno. Lui è un capoccione, esagera sempre. Ha bisogno d'affetto, come tanti giocatori. Ha bisogno anche di prendere le mazzate nei denti, vuol giocare come dice lui. Il merito su quel che sta facendo è suo. Sono contento che abbia fatto gol di sinistro. Sono contento di tutti, sono felice di allenarli. Oggi mi dispiace che Dele abbia fatto 11 minuti, meriterebbe molto di più. Tanti altri meriterebbero di fare qualche minuto in più, si allenano in un modo incredibile.

Industry observers note that isaksen? Dentro non si passava oggi, dovevamo andare in verticale. L'abbiamo fatto pochissime volte, e quelle poche volte siamo rusciti a mettere pensiero. Anche Noslin oggi a livello tecnico ha sbagliato tanto. Isaksen è un piacere lavorare con lui, ha risolto i suoi problemi. Quest'estate l'abbiamo perso per un po', è un giocatore che riesce a fare delle cose in velocità. Ha la terza marcia con la palla al piede. Ha preso gusto a far gol, e anche a far assist. Ha fatto una partita incredibile anche con la Danimarca.

Supercoppa? Per me è un regalo, io non c'entro nulla. Non è un impiccio, anzi. È una coppa. Manca un mese, pensa se possiamo pensare alla coppa. Quando arriverà, ci penseremo. Stai lì, provi a giocartela, giochi contro una squadra che sta dettando legge. Adesso recuperiamo due giorni e poi da martedì iniziano a preparare la sfida contro il Torino.

Qual è il segreto di questa Lazio? Noi proponiamo, però chi propone deve avere dall'altra parte gente che ci crede fortemente. Quando il giocatore la pensa in maniera diversa, lì viene il difficile. Bisogna esser bravi a fargli capire perché vogliamo fare determinate cose. Siamo stati bravi noi, sono bravi loro quando facciamo i lavori individuali. Con tutta questa organizzazione che abbiamo messo giù, loro si trovano bene. Noi proponiamo e per il momento tutto sta andando bene. Le ultime dai campi e le probabili formazioni di Atalanta-Inter:.

Recent findings suggest that la ripresa dell’Atalanta ricomincia contro i Campioni d’Italia dell’Inter dove l’obiettivo sarà quello di giocarsi tutto vista la classifica. Sarri va verso il 4-2-3-1 per la squadra orobica con Carnesecchi in porta; difesa a 4 con Kolasinac e Scalvini in mezzo mentre sulle fasce Bellanova ritornerebbe a destra mentre a sinistra ballottaggio tra Zappacosta e Bernasconi; a centrocampo confermato Ederson mentre c'è ballottaggio tra Gaetano e Kessié. Davanti un mix di ballottaggi e conferme: Elmas a destra, De Ketelaere al centro e a sinistra un testa a testa tra Rowe e Zalewski. Davanti Krstovic favorito su Scamacca. (da Bergamo, Filippo Davide Di Santo).

It has been revealed that atalanta e Inter si affrontano domenica sera nel posticipo della dodicesima giornata di Serie A. La sfida arriva dopo la sosta per le nazionali, con i nerazzurri di Chivu intenzionati a ripartire con il piede giusto. Buone notizie arrivano soprattutto da Marcus Thuram, che ha smaltito l'affaticamento muscolare accusato durante gli impegni con la Francia ed è pronto a tornare a disposizione dal primo minuto. Per Lautaro invece è prevista cautela. Per la trasferta di Bergamo, Chivu riparte da Martinez in porta dietro alla linea difensiva che dovrebbe essere composta da Bisseck, Bastoni e Carlos Augusto. Sulle fasce Spence e Dimarco sono favoriti, mentre in mezzo al campo spazio a Barella, Calhanoglu e Sucic. In attacco, Pio Esposito in forma smagliante dovrebbe affiancare proprio Thuram. (da Milano, Marta Bonfiglio).

Wiegman announced her squad on Tuesday morning, turning to England's younger generation for the double-header against Ukraine.

Izzy Goodwin is the latest emerging talent to receive a call-up to the Lionesses squad, after Lexi Potter, Erica Meg Parkinson and Freya Godfrey won their first caps in the previous round against Greece.

The 23-year-old London City Lionesses striker scored the equaliser against Kelly's Arsenal last weekend at the Emirates, with the home side dropping points yet again.

Chloe Kelly looked glamorous in a long-flowing navy dress at GQ Men of the Year 2026.

The 27-year-old missed out on Wiegman's England squad for the second time in a row.

Industry observers note that 'She responded really well (to being dropped last camp),' Wiegman said: 'Working really hard, she came in and was ready straight away. Going back to club she's done well and that's what has been fed back to me, too.'.

As for Kelly, however, it has since been confirmed that she has been struggling with a hamstring injury which has kept her from competitive first-team action since the end of September.

The winger has started just one game for Arsenal, a 0-0 draw with Crystal Palace, and has not registered any goals or assists. She has yet to complete 90 minutes in the WSL this season.

She was previously omitted from Wiegman's squad in 2025 for a lack of playing time as she fought with Mary Fowler for minutes - a disappointment that inspired her move to London from Manchester City.

Kelly was joined by former Arsenal and England legend Alex Scott.

Kelly has been battling a hamstring injury that has plagued her since the end of September.

Known for showing up in major moments, it was a gamble that paid off and Kelly scored the winning penalty against Spain to win Euros 2025, earning her the nickname Chloe 'clutch' Kelly.

Kelly will have to steal the spotlight yet again to get a glimpse of Wiegman's England side.

Villa end goal drought to finally give Emery’s fresh era lift-off

📅 08 Sep 2026 | ⏱️ 26 min read (5122 words, 📚 Deep Dive) | Source: Co

⏱️ ~26 mins left to finish
📖 0% read
💡 Key Takeaways
  • Unai Emery is building Aston Villa 2.0 and this was a night when his new kids on the block produced clear signs of lift-off for the next chapter.
  • Emery always springs into life on European nights and his reconstructed team secured their first win and goals of the season to leave Villa’s 1,700 fans singing in the rain.
  • Ten summer signings have arrived during a summer of upheaval, which included plenty of high-profile departures after the club’s Europa League triumph in May.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Unai Emery is building Aston Villa 2.0 and this was a night when his new kids on the block produced clear signs of lift-off for the next chapter.

Emery always springs into life on European nights and his reconstructed team secured their first win and goals of the season to leave Villa’s 1,700 fans singing in the rain.

Ten summer signings have arrived during a summer of upheaval, which included plenty of high-profile departures after the club’s Europa League triumph in May.

Yet this was an evening that will have further energised Emery on his return to the Champions League.

Nicolas Jackson, Zion Suzuki and João Gomes embody this newly introduced Villa team and all stood out here in Bruges.

Record £65m signing Jackson’s fine individual goal proved to be the winner to settle a chaotic, absorbing contest with the Belgian Pro League champions.

Recent findings suggest that jackson adds a third for Aston Villa after Sommer comes rushing out of his box! 😱📺 Watch live on TNT Sports & HBO Max pic.twitter.com/HZ1x3BkfK0.

Suzuki, the £30m replacement for Emiliano Martínez, has clear presence in goal and he is Villa’s version of former Manchester City goalkeeper Ederson with his wide array of passing.

Gomes was also industrious in midfield to recover from what was a nightmarish debut at Brighton, where he was sent off after 40 minutes.

Despite all the changes to this team, talismanic captain John McGinn remains essential to Villa. He became their all-time leading goalscorer in major European competitions with his 12th goal and led by example again, as he has done so many times.

Industry observers note that mcGinn strikes to put Villa ahead in Bruges! 💥📺 Watch live on TNT Sports & HBO Max pic.twitter.com/FJnuxSwYwo.

There were also hints of a strong defensive partnership developing between Pau Torres and Victor Lindelof, following the sale of Ezri Konsa to Arsenal last month.

“Fantastic, fantastic,” purred Emery at one point in the second half from the technical area, and Villa’s season now appears up and running.

Emery stated: “This was another step forward and I am so happy and thankful for this. The old players need to keep our standards high and show everyone this is the only way we can achieve the process and reach our targets.

Sources indicate that “It’s very important to start the Champions League with three points and hopefully this will give us confidence for the league. We are improving and we must work hard – it is the only way.”.

Although Emery has established a reputation as the Europa League king, winning that trophy five times, this competition has proved more difficult to master.

His best run was reaching the semi-finals in the 2021-22 season, when his Villarreal side lost to Liverpool.

It remains a tournament in which he is desperate to make an impression, with Villa returning to Champions League duty here for the first time since their thrilling encounter with Paris St-Germain in April 2025.

Only five of that starting XI from the second leg of the quarter-final remain and one of them, midfielder Amadou Onana, is out until next year after sustaining a serious knee injury at the World Cup with Belgium.

With European heavyweights Barcelona, PSG and Borussia Dortmund to come in the league phase, this always felt like a game Villa probably needed to win.

They had only managed one shot on target so far this season before arriving in this historic city, but scored three goals before half-time.

According to recent reports, their opener came against the run of play in the 11th minute, with McGinn casually finding the corner after a lung-bursting run from Torres. McGinn has overtaken former Villa striker Ollie Watkins at the top of the club’s continental goalscoring charts.

Brugge briefly wobbled but were level eight minutes later when Hugo Vetlesen swept home from 10 yards, capitalising on space in the penalty box.

According to recent reports, vetlesen draws Club Brugge level against Aston Villa! ⚡📺 Watch live on TNT Sports & HBO Max pic.twitter.com/4ZYwPcMHim.

In a recent development, villa were back in front less than 160 seconds later, with Gomes teeing up Emiliano Buendía for an easy finish. Gomes was released in the box by a clever backheel from Jackson.

Buendia restores Villa's lead just minutes after Club Brugge's equaliser, and Unai Emery is LOVING it! 🙌📺 Watch live on TNT Sports & HBO Max pic.twitter.com/h2WGkwkTI1.

Two minutes before half-time Yann Sommer, Club Brugge’s new goalkeeper, then had a severe rush of blood to the head by racing from his goal to almost the halfway line in an attempt to intercept Torres’s long pass.

In a recent development, jackson edged the ball past him and held off a defender to calmly slot into the empty net. He underlined in many moments why Emery has pursued him for so long, after the pair established a strong rapport at Villarreal.

Villa appeared relatively comfortable in the second half until Aaron Wan-Bissaka was judged to have handled a cross from Joaquin Seys, after referee Sandro Schärer was advised by VAR to review the incident on his TV monitor.

It was a simple decision and Nicolò Tresoldi put away the penalty to stir life back into the home supporters.

Club Brugge are back in it from the penalty spot after Wan-Bissaka's handball! 👀📺 Watch live on TNT Sports & HBO Max pic.twitter.com/pEanRJvimu.

According to recent reports, villa defended resolutely as time began to tick away with Suzuki providing authority in goal. The first Japanese goalkeeper to play in the Champions League also produced a number of routine saves in a nervy finish.

This was a promising night for a latest Villa era.

In a recent development, full-time scenes in Bruges as Aston Villa get their Champions League campaign off to a winning start! 👏📺 Watch live on TNT Sports & HBO Max pic.twitter.com/nYwtiQ6Xs7.

According to recent reports, villa are defending with six at the back as midfield and defence merge into one. There are seconds remaining as Suzuki punts the ball up field and there is the final whistle! Villa make a winning start to the 2026-27 Champions League.

Another cross from the right is met, this time, by Tresoldi, but his header has no bite and Suzuki gathers.

Torres heads another Siquet cross behind for a corner. Brugge load the box but none of their players are able to get a meaningful touch on the ball before Diakhon slips just as he looks to get a shot away from the left of the box.

Slightly less mature play from Gomes, though. He bundles Vermant over and earns a needless yellow card.

Really mature play by Hemmings. Looking to break away, he simply puts his body between man and ball, inviting the challenge and winning a foul.

Villa are working hard in their compact mid-block and Brugge are struggling to find a way through.

Leko sends on Vermant and Diakhon for Potts and Virgili.

Sources indicate that barkley is one lucky boy. Attempting to play out under pressure, the midfielder gives the ball straight to Virgili, who cannot sort out his feet before offloading to Tresoldi far too late. A significant let-off for Villa.

Gomes goes close after driving through Brugge’s midfield. He really should, though, have played in a free McGinn at the back post. Moments later Bogarde fires another shot goalwards but Sommer gets to it.

Abraham replaces goalscorer Jackson.

Sources indicate that villa have wrestled control away from their opponents. McGinn’s teasing cross evades everyone and Alysson’s cross takes a deflection which goes behind for a corner which is not up to much.

Lee hauls down Hemmings which gives Villa the opportunity to slow the game down. McGinn flights a delivery in from the left but Brugge clear their lines.

The ball comes out to Alysson who jinks in from the right, tiptoeing through a crowd, desperate to get a shot away on his left foot, but Seys does well to track his man and smother the effort.

Vanakan and Velesen and replaced by Tsawa and Lemarechal.

Industry observers note that yet another dangerous Siquet cross rains in from the right and here it is taken off Tresoldi’s toes by the tip of Lindelof’s boot. The defender did brilliantly to clear his lines at full stretch.

According to recent reports, hemmings burst towards the by-line and his cross trickles across the face of goal. Alysson is waiting at the far post but Seys does well to shield the ball and win a free-kick.

According to recent reports, villa’s best chance at putting this game to bed will come on the counter. And here McGinn plays in Jackson whose one-vs-one effort is stopped by Sommer.

Virgili from the left, Siquet from the right. Threats are coming from both wings and Villa need to get their foot on the ball if they are to take the sting out of Brugge’s attack.

Instead they allow Vetlesen a yard of space and his long-range sighter stings the hands of Suzuki who turns behind for a corner.

Emery switches out Buendia, Kamara and Wan-Bissaka for Alysson, Barkley and Bogarde before the corner is taken, and Suzuki stops the eventual delivery on the line after the ball spun off the post!

Recent findings suggest that another Virgili cross threatens to carve Villa open but they just about clear their lines. Then it is Siquet who delivers, this time from the right, but his cross just evades Tresoldi and Mechele at the far post. The home fans are invested in this, they believe their side can grab an equaliser...

Villa have got their tails between their legs here. From a position of strength, they have allowed the momentum to swing in the hosts’ favour and it has been largely self-inflicted.

Maatsen has a chance to break free but cannot build a head of steam before he is stymied.

In a recent development, club Brugge 2 Aston Villa 3 (Tresoldi pen) Suzuki dives to his right early and Tresoldi slides the ball into the opposite side of the net. Just the one goal in it now!

In a recent development, club Brugge are back in it from the penalty spot after Wan-Bissaka's handball! 👀📺 Watch live on TNT Sports & HBO Max pic.twitter.com/pEanRJvimu.

Brugge have averted their attention to their right hand side, Siquet and Forbs attacking in tandem. A dangerous cross from Forbs is met by Tresoldi but he cannot get the requisite contact on it. Seys collects the ball on the far side and fires a delivery into Wan-Bissaka and out for a corner. Replays show that it comes off the defenders hand ...and referee Scharer is sent to the screen. He wastes no time at the monitor and awards a spot kick!

Villa do appear pretty comfortable here, despite some frequent pressure from Club Brugge.

Pau Torres has been outstanding so far at the back for Unai Emery’s team.

This is also a night where Emery’s ‘newly introduced’ Villa are coming of age, with Nicolas Jackson, Zion Suzuki and Joao Gomes also impressive.

Aston Villa are back in the Champions League and in familiar territory with an unfamiliar team.

This will be their third match at the Jan BreydelStadion in less than two years but much has changed with the players that last competed here for Unai Emery.

Two of the goalscorers in the club’s last outing in Bruges were Leon Bailey and Marco Asensio, who are no longer at the club.

Of course, they are not the only players that have left and this is a fresh-look Emery team hoping for lift-off this season.

Villa are the Europa League winners but this could be a tricky evening against the Belgian Pro League champions.

Sources indicate that good evening and welcome to live coverage of Aston Villa’s Champions League opener against Club Brugge. Unai Emery’s side voyage across the Channel to face the Belgian champions having triumphed in last season’s Europa League and finished fourth in the Premier League. The Villa mothership has since sailed into choppy waters, though, with a raft of big-name sales preceding a run of two defeats and a draw in the league. An opening-weekend thrashing by Brighton and Hove Albion proved quite the storm for Emery’s fresh-look crew.

Morgan Rogers alighted for Chelsea in a deal worth £117m, a record fee for an English player, and goalkeeper Emiliano Martínez followed soon after, while Youri Tielemans moved to Manchester United. Ezri Konsa and Ollie Watkins completed the exodus of leading men with late-August moves to Arsenal and Al-Hilal respectively. To remedy the outgoings, Villa twice broke their transfer record this summer, pipping Newcastle United to the signing of Johan Manzambi (£59.5m) before landing Nicolas Jackson (£65m, including add-ons), and added Taylor Harwood-Bellis and Ibrahim Mbaye on deadline day. Whether they can hit the ground running remains to be seen, but Emery has a task on his hands aligning his new recruits before the scrutiny intensifies.

Although Villa swept aside Brugge 6-1 across two legs in the Champions League quarter-finals two seasons ago, here Blauw-Zwart (Blue-Black) represent a stern test having made the Jan Breydel Stadium a fortress in last year’s tournament. Their only home defeat in the league phase came against Arsenal, with a 3-3 draw against Barcelona backed up by 4-1 and 3-0 victories over Monaco and Marseille respectively. Belgium’s second-most decorated club have won seven of the last 11 league titles and know how to win matches. In Yann Sommer, Ivan Leko has one of world football’s most experienced goalkeepers, who kept the most clean sheets in the 2024-25 edition of the Champions League (seven). Captain Hans Vanakan, Brandon Mechele and Joaquin Seys were part of Rudi Garcia’s Belgium World Cup squad, and German striker Nicolò Tresoldi already has four goals in six matches this term. English midfielder Freddie Potts could also feature, having settled in nicely in West Flanders having moved from West Ham United during the summer.

The earlier 5.45pm kick-off time, means Villa, Brugge, LASK and AEK Athens have the opportunity to top the 36-team league …at least for a couple of hours.

It’s now coming up to six months since Arne Slot was relieved of his duties as Liverpool head coach after two years in the role.

The Dutchman had the unenviable task of succeeding Jurgen Klopp in the Anfield dugout but delivered a surprise (and emphatic) Premier League title triumph in his first season in charge before the Reds’ fortunes nosedived dramatically last term.

The 48-year-old just about managed to achieve Champions League qualification in May, but the extent of the decline from 12 months previously made his position untenable, and he was dismissed to make way for Andoni Iraola.

In his latest Liverpool Confidential feature for the Daily Mail, Lewis Steele addressed the question of what Slot has been getting up to since his exit from Anfield, with the journalist ‘often asked’ about the Dutch tactician’s more recent endeavours.

He outlined that the former Reds boss has been ‘biding his time and enjoying holidays with loved ones’, including multiple trips to Ibiza and taking in football matches in Argentina and Brazil with his son Joep, along with attending games in his native Netherlands.

The 48-year-old turned down the chance to coach his country after the World Cup, as well as potentially ‘lucrative gig’ in Saudi Arabia. He also declined approaches from a few clubs in the summer, including AC Milan, who now have ex-Manchester United boss Ruben Amorim in charge.

Steele concluded that Slot is ‘waiting for the right opportunity’ to get back into the dugout and doesn’t believe that his ‘stock has fallen’ as much as some of his peers who’ve been sacked by other high-profile Premier League clubs.

It has been revealed that want more Empire of the Kop coverage? Add us as a preferred source on Google to your favourites list for news you can trust.

The Dutchman’s Liverpool tenure may have ended on a low ebb, and the prevailing sentiment in May was that the time was right for a change, but it’d be wrong to describe his two-year spell at Anfield as a failure.

He vastly exceeded expectations by winning the Premier League at the first attempt, and while last season was undoubtedly a massive underachievement results-wise, it must be viewed in the context of Slot and the squad trying to navigate the horrendous grief of Diogo Jota’s tragic death.

That the 48-year-old has turned down job approaches in order to hold out for the ‘right opportunity’ indicates his confidence that he’ll get back on board the managerial carousel sooner rather than later, and that his reputation hasn’t been overly tarnished by the disappointment of 2025/26.

Most Liverpool fans would also acknowledge that Slot carried himself with tremendous dignity throughout his time with us, striking the perfect tone with his farewell message to supporters after his sacking and – most importantly – handling the loss of Jota with commendable grace.

It’s nice to hear that the Dutchman has been enjoying his time with family since departing Merseyside, and it wouldn’t surprise us in the slightest if he were to be back in the technical area with a fresh club over the next few months.

Wherever his career might take him from here, we wish him the best in his future endeavours.

Scegli Fcinter1908.it come tuo sito preferito su Google: clicca qui.

Si avvicina la ripresa del campionato dopo la sosta per le Nazionali, e l'Inter si prepara ad affrontare la trasferta di Bergamo contro l'Atalanta, valida per la 12ª giornata di Serie A. I nerazzurri, secondi in classifica a quota 28 punti, sono reduci dalla vittoria di San Siro contro il Como nell'ultimo impegno prima della pausa, mentre la squadra di Sarri ha conquistato tre punti in casa del Monza nell'ultimo turno e occupa la dodicesima posizione in classifica con 14 punti.

In a recent development, sono 130 i precedenti tra Inter e Atalanta in Serie A: i meneghini contano 71 successi contro i 24 dei bergamaschi, con 35 pareggi a completare il quadro. L'Inter è la squadra contro cui l'Atalanta ha perso più partite (71) e ha subito più gol (234) nella massima serie. L'Inter è reduce da una serie positiva contro la Dea, avendo collezionato sette vittorie e un pareggio nelle ultime otto sfide di Serie A, dopo aver raccolto due successi nelle nove precedenti sfide nella competizione (6N, 1P). Per quanto riguarda i precedenti a Bergamo, l'Inter ha conquistato quattro vittorie negli ultimi quattro confronti: sono 25 i successi meneghini in casa della Dea, con 25 pareggi e 15 vittorie dell'Atalanta a completare il bilancio.

L'Inter ha iniziato il campionato con 9 vittorie nelle prime 11 giornate, realizzando 28 reti e subendone 13. I nerazzurri hanno sempre cercato di imporre il proprio gioco contro ogni avversario affrontato, come testimoniano i dati sul possesso palla (60,7% a partita, secondo miglior dato del campionato) e quelli sulle conclusioni tentate e subite: l’Inter è infatti la squadra che ha effettuato più tiri (234) e che ne ha concessi meno (108) nella Serie A in corso. La differenza tra tiri fatti e subiti è di +126: solo Barcellona (+154) e Bayern Monaco (+127) ne hanno una più ampia nei cinque grandi campionati europei 2026/27.

La squadra di Chivu è anche quella col maggior numero di legni colpiti (10), quella con più palloni toccati (452) in area avversaria e quella che ha realizzato più reti da palla inattiva (8). I nerazzurri hanno dimostrato carattere e voglia di vincere in ogni occasione in questo avvio di stagione, riuscendo quasi sempre a ribaltare uno svantaggio iniziale nei finali di partita: i 13 punti ottenuti dall’Inter da situazioni di svantaggio in questa Serie A sono un record considerando i cinque grandi campionati europei 2026/27. Punti arrivati grazie alla lucidità e alle qualità espresse negli ultimi minuti di partita: quella di Chivu è la squadra che ha ottenuto più punti con gol segnati dopo il 75° minuto di gioco in questa Serie A (nove, più del del doppio rispetto a ogni altra).
